contentPattern.structure: image | text (richtext); options: image side (left/right), image alignment (bottom/centre/top)

suitableFor: intro sections with a character illustration beside the copy
promo panels with a product/vehicle image and a CTA

implementationNote: Block-based component (block/v1/block) with one model: image + imageAlt + text, plus grouped block options classes_position (right) and classes_align (center / top). decorate() only classes the authored rows, so UE field bindings are preserved.
